mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.25% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing recovery regime (HOUST > 900.0), strong new home construction signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with HOUST > 900.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 2.5 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 430000.0) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with RSAFS > 430000.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing market (HOUST < 900.0) signals reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST < 900.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
